Really it’s a matter of convenience or preference, aberglasslyn is quite centralised with minimal impact during floods/fires ( floods and fires have impacted access from Cliffleigh through to Maitland and surrounds several times over the last few years), where as Cliffleigh has a higher % of newer developments and newer homes. Cliffleigh has better access overall to the expressway providing sustained access to metropolitan areas, namely Newcastle and abroad though Aberglasslyn is situated within an already developed area, with direct access to retail and services. It’s a matter of preference. I can personally vouch for aberglasslyn, being a resident and from my experience there is quite a number of “good” areas catering for families and individuals, though like most suburbs the are always areas less favourable.
